title: Refine framework service status reporting under podman-compose
description: podman 5.8 + podman-compose 1.5 reports framework/locust as 'Up X (starting)' indefinitely because they have no healthcheck. Cosmetic only — Step D (curl :4000/stats) confirms framework actually serves traffic. Two options: (a) add a trivial /stats-based HEALTHCHECK in docker-compose.yml (NOT in the Dockerfile, that would require a /healthz endpoint which is anti-scope); (b) leave as-is, document in RUNBOOK (Phase 5). Recommend (b) for now.
acceptance_criteria: Phase 5 RUNBOOK documents the cosmetic '(starting)' status; no functional change.

title: Pre-pull base images on first make up to avoid Docker Hub anon throttle
description: First-run make up may fail with 'unable to retrieve auth token' from Docker Hub due to anonymous-pull throttling, observed during Phase 0 integration gate. Suggested fix: add a 'make bootstrap' target that runs 'podman pull postgres:15-alpine redis:7-alpine python:3.14-slim' before the first make up, plus a README note. Not Phase 0 blocking.
acceptance_criteria: make bootstrap exists; README mentions running it on first clone.

title: Bump pytest-asyncio to remove Python 3.14 deprecation warnings
description: pytest-asyncio 0.24.0 emits 47 DeprecationWarning lines on every test run (asyncio.iscoroutinefunction and asyncio.get_event_loop_policy are deprecated in 3.14, removal in 3.16). Not breaking anything. Fix when pytest-asyncio releases a 3.14-clean version (>0.24, likely >=0.25), or apply a warning filter in pyproject.toml's [tool.pytest.ini_options] as a stopgap.
acceptance_criteria: poetry run pytest tests/ -W error::DeprecationWarning passes (no deprecation warnings).
